description: Use a Last Price API key you already hold (a saved file, LASTPRICE_API_KEY) in this MCP connection, when it was opened without one: pass api_key. On the hosted MCP server this session then runs as that key's agent, so the tools that need a credential work at once with no header to add; it lasts until the session ends or the key is revoked or rotated. The key is checked, never echoed back. A connection that already has a credential keeps it. Public: needs no other credential.

api_key.description: Your Last Price API key: lp_ and 40 lowercase hex characters.

name: use_api_key
